summary: Inspect an object’s own enumerable property names.
documentation: Object.keys builds an array of an object’s own enumerable string-keyed property names. It does not include symbol keys or inherited properties. Sort the returned keys when a report needs alphabetical order.
inputs: An object whose own keys should be inspected.
returns: An array of string property names.
caution: Integer-like keys have special enumeration order. Do not assume insertion order equals alphabetical order.
scenarios: List editable fields supplied by a form configuration.
Inspect column names in an imported JSON record.
Build a compact checklist of enabled configuration fields.
title: List supplied profile fields
problem: Input is a JSON object. Return its own property names sorted using JavaScript’s default string sort. Include keys whose values are null, false or zero.
goal: Use Object.keys() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Collect keys, then sort the resulting array.
